name: 根来寺大塔
checkpoints: TWO roofs: five-bay square lower skirt, white plaster rounded dome above, cylindrical upper timber body and square pyramidal tiled upper roof.
Preserve the exceptionally broad lower storey, tall central finial, veranda railings and central stone staircase; show all of the actual tower.
No other buildings, trees, visitors or surrounding wires.
